summary.zh: 按 WCAG 2.2 扫描并修复无障碍问题
summary.en: Audit WCAG 2.2 accessibility, check contrast, then fix and re-verify.

description.zh: 扫描 React、Next.js、Vue、Angular、Svelte 和静态 HTML 页面的无障碍缺陷，核对颜色对比度并生成合规报告，修复后复检确认问题已消失。适合上线前的无障碍检查、WCAG 2.2 A/AA 达标和接入 CI 的持续检查。扫描脚本依赖本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Scans React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte and plain HTML for accessibility faults, checks contrast, writes a report and re-checks after fixes. Good for pre-launch checks, WCAG 2.2 A/AA work and CI gating. Scanners need local Python.
